candidate.derivedAnswer: B: Plan B costs less, saving 5 yuan.
candidate.answerReason: At 500 minutes, Plan A costs 80 yuan and Plan B costs 75 yuan.

methods.label: Compare total charges
methods.explanation: Plan A: \(30+0.1\times500=80\) yuan; Plan B: \(0.15\times500=75\) yuan. Plan B costs less. (The two plans cost the same when \(30+0.1t=0.15t\), giving \(t=600\). Plan B costs less for fewer than 600 minutes of calls.)
methods.levelReason: The requested comparison uses elementary decimal arithmetic. The retained additional break-even calculation uses a Grade 7 linear equation.

methods.label: Compare the fee with the call savings
methods.explanation: Plan A saves \(0.15-0.10=0.05\) yuan per minute in call charges. Over \(500\) minutes, this saves \(0.05\times500=25\) yuan. Its monthly fee is \(30\) yuan, which exceeds these savings by \(30-25=5\) yuan. Therefore, Plan B costs \(5\) yuan less. Choose B.
methods.levelReason: Comparing the reduction in call charges with the fixed monthly fee requires only elementary arithmetic and no equation.

candidate.annotationRationale:
The task assesses applying decimal rates to compare actual costs at a specified duration (cnm_p134). Both methods use rate times quantity, decimal multiplication by an integer, and comparison of whole-number amounts. Only the retained method includes finding the break-even duration, so cnm_049 and cnm_042 belong to that method, with letters and equality properties as local prerequisites. The alternative instead subtracts the rates and compares the resulting savings with the fee.
